data.name: Phola Coal Processing Plant
data.processing_type: DMS (Dense Media Separation) â€” dual module
data.approximate_throughput: 16 Mtpa (one of the largest single-site coal processing plants in South Africa)
data.notes: Joint venture (Thungela 50%, Anglo American historical) near Ogies, Mpumalanga. Processes coal from multiple mine sources; historically accepted third-party ROM feeds; large-scale DMS cyclone plant
data.competitive_threat_level: High â€” direct DMS competitor with massive scale

data.name: Msobo Coal
data.notes: Headquartered in Breyten, Msukaligwa Municipality, Mpumalanga. Manages multiple coal washing plants and four (4) rail sidings â€” strong logistics advantage. Processes for own operations; potential third-party capacity unknown
data.competitive_threat_level: Medium â€” similar rail-siding model to Veralogix Plant; local competitor

data.name: LI Coal Resources
data.processing_type: Washing plants (Elendspruite and Madin plants); produces 27CV, duff, peas, small nuts, 0-50mm RB1
data.notes: Operates Elendspruite and Madin washing plants in Mpumalanga and Limpopo. Business spans prospecting, exploration, coal trading, and blending sites across Mpumalanga, Limpopo, and KZN. Multi-site processing presence is a competitive advantage
data.competitive_threat_level: Medium â€” multi-site processing presence across Mpumalanga and Limpopo

data.name: Optimum Coal / Liberty Coal (Woestalleen area)
data.notes: Former BHP/Glencore/Gupta-era asset; wash plant has a complex ownership and operational history. Illegal use of the wash plant was reported in 2025 (via artisanal miners). Now under Liberty Coal management. Proximity to Woestalleen makes this a direct geographic competitor
data.competitive_threat_level: High â€” geographically proximate; large-scale DMS plant; same export corridor

data.name: Mafube Coal Mine (Exxaro / Thungela 50/50 JV)
data.processing_type: DMS coal handling and processing plant
data.notes: Located 30 km east of Middelburg, Mpumalanga. Joint operation between Exxaro and Thungela. Integrated mine-to-washery with own processing infrastructure; not a known toll washer but competes for the same ROM coal feed
data.competitive_threat_level: Medium â€” integrated captive plant, not a toll washing competitor per se, but reduces available ROM coal for third-party processors

data.name: Seriti Power (Kriel / Matla / Goedgevonden area plants)
data.approximate_throughput: Largest supplier to Eskom; total group production ~70 Mtpa
data.notes: Largest SA coal supplier to Eskom and significant RBCT exporter. Integrated processing operations across multiple Mpumalanga mines. Not a toll washer, but the scale and rail access of Seriti operations sets the competitive pricing floor for processing in the region
data.competitive_threat_level: Low-Medium â€” not a direct toll washing competitor but influences market pricing and rail slot availability

data.name: Kangala Coal Mine DMS Plant (Universal Coal / Menar)
data.processing_type: DMS washing plant (320 tph dual stage)
data.notes: Located in Witbank, Mpumalanga. Two-stage processing: 320 tph DMS plant plus crushing and screening. Integrated mine plant; potential spare capacity for third-party processing not publicly confirmed
data.competitive_threat_level: Low-Medium â€” integrated plant, limited toll washing appetite known

data.name: DMO / Douglas-Middelburg Plant (South32 legacy)
data.processing_type: DMS (twin 1150mm cyclone, 4.2m vibrating screens) â€” one of the world's largest 2-module DMS configurations
data.notes: Originally built for BHP Billiton Energy Coal SA (BECSA) by DRA Global; designed for export and Eskom supply until 2034. Massive scale; now under South32 operations. Not a toll washer, but defines the benchmark for DMS plant technology and throughput in the Mpumalanga region
data.competitive_threat_level: Low â€” different ownership tier; not a toll washing competitor directly
